topic.title: Flip a coin and prevent damage

messages.content: How to get the data that a coin flipped after attack used? For example: {'attackId': 1266, 'name': 'Splashing Dodge', 'text': 'Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent’s next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.', 'damage': 10, 'energies': [0]} Thank you
